title: Ionic interactions of copper(II) sulfate in water, aqueous maltose, and aqueous lactose at different temperatures: a volumetric and thermodynamic study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35201-35218
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03403E, Paper

Syed Muhammad Saqib Nadeem, Rehana Saeed, Moattar Ali
Densities of pure water, aqueous maltose, and aqueous lactose solvents were measured at temperatures of 303.15, 308.15, 313.15, 318.15, and 323.15 K before and after the addition of different concentrations of copper(II) sulfate.
